name: Display comfort
description: Persistent chat text size and an arbitrary page zoom for the KiroCrew dashboard. A settings page with two sliders: chat text scale (50–250 %, applied to every message bubble, optionally the composer too) and page zoom (25–300 % in 1 % steps, any value — not just the browser's fixed stops). Both persist in the mod's config, apply live as you drag, and are restored before the first paint on the next load so nothing flashes at the default size. Answers the upstream quality-of-life requests for a chat font-size control and a free-form zoom value. Unofficial.
